scope: Promote the already reviewed DELL official-transcript successor into the current three-case Workbench composition without copying private objects or changing MU/NVDA.
positive_results: DELL can resolve from a digest-bound per-case private root while MU and NVDA continue using the default immutable root.
Current composition recomputes DELL summary counts from the reviewed Pack instead of trusting manually entered counts.
Workspace DELL artifact and Pack payload bindings update together while MU/NVDA bindings remain unchanged.
The Runtime Registry replacement is assembled only after the new current result and Workspace payloads are rendered and digest-bound.
